attackers_goals: Elevate privileges from standard domain user to domain admin.
description: A Kerberos service ticket (ST) was requested for an account with a spoofed sAMAccountName.
investigative_actions: Check if the domain controller is patched or vulnerable to the attack. Look for associated sAMAccountName rename events. Follow actions by the account and if it performed a DCSync.
name: Service ticket request with a spoofed sAMAccountName
required_data: XDR Agent with eXtended Threat Hunting (XTH)
